name: Yukizuki no Seisou
source:
Sousuke Kusaka is a second-sighted high school boy.
During winter holidays, he decides to go on an excursion to a
small town with his friend..
What awaits him in this snow-covered mysterious town?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036688.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
久坂宗丞是一名拥有预知能力的高中男生。
寒假期间，他决定与朋友一起，去一座小镇短途旅行。
在这座白雪覆盖的神秘小镇里，等待他的究竟是什么？
